plan.claim: Holding constant the routes, months, departure hours and aircraft types each carrier flies changes the carrier ranking on arrival delay.
plan.estimator: Arrival delay on carrier with route, month, departure hour and aircraft type fixed effects, weighted least squares on cells; effects relative to the flight weighted average carrier.
plan.family: Pairwise rank changes are described, not tested.
plan.interval: Cluster robust by day, scores summed over flights.
plan.simulator: Rank correlation with the true ranking, adjusted against raw (recovery study).
plan.split: choose on 2015 to 2022, report on 2023 to the latest month; the specification was settled on the fitting years and the ranking is fit on 2023 onward.
plan.test: Rank changes between the raw and the adjusted ranking; effects with intervals.
plan.title: The fair ranking
